name: level-blockout
description: A graybox level from a brief: the level designer's beat sheet, a generated or hand-made layout proven finishable (the platformer solver, start-to-exit paths), the level wired into the game (web template, Godot or Unreal), the engine's checks, and bots that finish it.

brief.description: The level: what it teaches, its beats (intro, challenge, twist, finale), its size, its difficulty.

engine.description: "web", "godot" or "unreal" (the game already in the workspace)

kind.description: platformer, dungeon, cave, maze, topdown or wfc (the studio_procgen generator), or "hand" for rows written by hand

beats.title: Beat sheet

make.title: Block it out
make.prompt: Stage: blockout-make. Make the level as a Studio level asset: studio_procgen {{input.kind}} (try seeds until the layout matches the beats; platformers come out proven by the solver) or, for hand-made rows, studio_procgen solve on them and save them as a level asset. Wire it into the game ({{input.engine}}: web game.json levels; godot: build the level from its rows in scripts/main.gd; unreal: harness_ue build_level from the rows), then game_bot {"mode": "goal"} until a bot finishes it.

fix.title: Fix
fix.prompt:
Stage: blockout-fix. The level checks failed. Fix the layout (another seed, a gap the jump clears, a path to the exit) or its wiring, and prove it again with game_bot goal.

{{feedback}}

failed.title: Stopped: the level checks still fail
